critic.fix_suggestion: Extend the upper-deck cylinder along the longitudinal axis of the fuselage. Increase its length by 25% to ensure it terminates significantly further back from the cockpit area, aligning with the reference model's proportions. Maintain the current radius while shifting the rear face position backward.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck hump ends very close to the cockpit area.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length of the upper-deck cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively flat and low compared to the main fuselage diameter.
discrepancies.reference: The hump has a more pronounced, rounded vertical rise from the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase height/radius of the upper-deck cylinder

discrepancies.observed: The transition from the nose to the hump is abrupt and angular.
discrepancies.reference: The transition is a smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: smooth the junction between the nose cone and upper deck

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck appears narrow and thin relative to the main fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The upper deck has a wider, more substantial volume.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase width of the upper-deck cylinder
